question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence says people must adapt to disruption in the labour market caused by rapid technological change.
 
• Blank (4) needs a word that describes someone who can adjust to new conditions and therefore keep updating skills.
 
• **Adaptable** means able to adjust easily to new conditions. (अनुकूलनीय)
 
• Example: *To survive in a fast-changing job market, workers must be adaptable and learn new skills.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4 — adaptable**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Proactive** (सक्रिय/पूर्व-सक्रिय) – Means taking initiative to act in advance. Useful trait, but the sentence stresses ability to adjust continually, so "adaptable" is a closer fit.

 *Example:* A proactive employee anticipates problems and acts before they arise.
 
• **Option 2: Stubborn** (ज़िद्दी) – Means refusing to change; opposite of what is needed here.

 *Example:* Being stubborn about old methods can harm one’s career in a changing industry.
 
• **Option 3: Reactive** (प्रतिक्रियाशील) – Means responding after events occur; less desirable than being adaptable (which implies flexible adjustment).

 *Example:* A reactive strategy waits for change instead of adjusting proactively.
